en.summary: ClipSaver for YouTube is a userscript that adds quick download controls to YouTube. It injects a download button into the video player's control bar and, on Shorts pages, shows a floating download button when you hover a video. A companion panel page lets you turn the floating button on or off, choose its position, size, icon size and edge offset, and trigger downloads for the current page.
en.problem: YouTube does not provide a built-in way to save videos or Shorts. This script gives you a fast, in-page shortcut: instead of copying the URL by hand and pasting it into a download service, you click or hover a download button that hands the current page URL to an external downloader.
en.audience: People who watch YouTube videos or Shorts and occasionally want to download them, and who already run a userscript manager (such as one that provides GM_openInTab / GM_setValue grants) in a desktop browser.
highlights: Adds a download button to the YouTube player control bar that acts on the current page.
On Shorts pages, shows a floating download button when you hover over a visible, ready video element.
Floating button can be positioned in 12 screen locations (top/bottom/left/right center and quarter positions).
Configurable button size, icon size and edge offset.
A companion panel page can enable or disable the floating button and apply configuration changes live.
Panel actions let you download the current video or open the download service directly.
Settings persist across sessions using userscript storage, with a localStorage fallback.
The current browser language is used to pick the language path of the download service.
usage: Install the userscript in a userscript-manager-enabled browser and visit a YouTube page.
On a video page, click the download icon in the player's control bar to send the current page to the download service.
On a Shorts page, move the mouse over the video to reveal the floating download button, then click it.
Open the companion panel page to access the Download Controls section.
Toggle 'Enable floating download button' and pick a button position from the available options.
Adjust button size, icon size and edge offset if the default appearance does not suit you.
Use the panel actions 'Download current video' or 'Open download service' to trigger a download from the panel.
limitations: Only runs on youtube.com pages and only acts on the current page URL; it does not process playlists, channels or batches.
It does not download files itself: it opens an external download service with the current URL, so the actual download depends on that service.
The floating hover button is only enabled on pages whose URL contains '/shorts/'; on other pages it is disabled.
The floating button only appears for video elements that are large enough, visible, and have loaded enough data to be ready.
The companion panel is opened once and only from the first page load that has not already connected; a stored flag prevents repeat opens.
In-memory logs are capped at 200 entries and are cleared on refresh; they are not persisted.

faq.q: Does the script download the video file by itself?
faq.a: No. It adds download buttons that forward the current page URL to an external download service; the actual download is handled by that service.

faq.q: Why don't I see the floating button on a regular video page?
faq.a: The floating hover button is enabled only on pages whose URL contains '/shorts/'. On regular video pages you use the download button in the player's control bar instead.

faq.q: Where do I change the button's position or size?
faq.a: Open the companion panel page. In the Download Controls section you can toggle the floating button and set its position, button size, icon size and edge offset.

faq.q: Are my settings saved?
faq.a: Yes. Configuration values are stored through userscript storage when available, with a localStorage fallback, so they persist across sessions.

faq.q: Can I disable the floating button?
faq.a: Yes. Use the 'Enable floating download button' switch in the companion panel to turn it off, and it can be re-enabled at any time.

en.safety: Permissions requested are limited to opening tabs, adding styles, and reading/writing userscript storage. When you trigger a download, the current page URL (including its language path selection based on your browser language) is sent to the external download service; nothing is sent otherwise. The panel communication channel validates messages by expected origin and source window and suppresses duplicates, and the script does not access your YouTube account or credentials. Running logs are kept only in an in-memory buffer (capped at 200 entries, cleared on refresh) and are not desensitized or persisted, so they may contain page error details during the session.

zh-CN.summary: ClipSaver for YouTube 是一款为 YouTube 增加快捷下载入口的用户脚本。它会在视频播放器控制栏中注入一个下载按钮，并在 Shorts 页面中于鼠标悬停视频时显示悬浮下载按钮。配套面板页可开关悬浮按钮，设置其位置、按钮尺寸、图标尺寸与边缘偏移，并可针对当前页面触发下载。
zh-CN.problem: YouTube 本身没有提供保存视频或 Shorts 的便捷方式。本脚本提供页面内的快速入口：无需手动复制网址再粘贴到下载服务，只需点击或悬停下载按钮，即可把当前页面网址交给外部下载器。
zh-CN.audience: 适合经常观看 YouTube 视频或 Shorts、偶尔需要下载的桌面浏览器用户，且已安装支持 GM_openInTab / GM_setValue 等授权的用户脚本管理器。
highlights: 在 YouTube 播放器控制栏中注入下载按钮，作用于当前页面。
在 Shorts 页面中，鼠标悬停于可见且已就绪的视频元素时显示悬浮下载按钮。
悬浮按钮支持 12 个屏幕位置（上下左右居中及四分之一位置）。
可配置按钮尺寸、图标尺寸与边缘偏移。
配套面板页可开关悬浮按钮，并实时应用配置更改。
面板动作支持下载当前视频或直接打开下载服务。
配置通过用户脚本存储持久保存，回退使用 localStorage。
根据浏览器语言选择下载服务的语言路径。
usage: 在支持用户脚本管理器的浏览器中安装脚本，然后访问 YouTube 页面。
在视频页面中，点击播放器控制栏中的下载图标，将当前页面发送到下载服务。
在 Shorts 页面中，把鼠标移动到视频上以显示悬浮下载按钮，然后点击它。
打开配套面板页，进入 Download Controls（下载控制）区域。
切换“Enable floating download button”开关，并从可用选项中选择按钮位置。
如默认外观不合适，可调整按钮尺寸、图标尺寸与边缘偏移。
使用面板动作“Download current video”或“Open download service”从面板触发下载。
limitations: 仅在 youtube.com 页面运行，且只处理当前页面网址，不处理播放列表、频道或批量下载。
脚本本身不下载文件：它会携带当前网址打开外部下载服务，实际下载取决于该服务。
悬浮悬停按钮仅在网址包含“/shorts/”的页面启用，其它页面会被禁用。
悬浮按钮仅对足够大、可见且已加载足够数据就绪的视频元素显示。
配套面板只会在首次尚未连接过的页面加载时自动打开一次，存储标记会阻止重复打开。
内存日志上限为 200 条，刷新即清空，不做持久化。

faq.q: 脚本会自己下载视频文件吗？
faq.a: 不会。它只是添加下载按钮，将当前页面网址转发给外部下载服务，实际下载由该服务完成。

faq.q: 为什么普通视频页看不到悬浮按钮？
faq.a: 悬浮悬停按钮仅在网址包含“/shorts/”的页面启用。普通视频页请使用播放器控制栏中的下载按钮。

faq.q: 在哪里修改按钮位置或尺寸？
faq.a: 打开配套面板页，在 Download Controls 区域可以开关悬浮按钮，并设置位置、按钮尺寸、图标尺寸与边缘偏移。

faq.q: 我的设置会被保存吗？
faq.a: 会。可用时通过用户脚本存储保存配置，并回退使用 localStorage，因此设置可跨会话保留。

faq.q: 可以关闭悬浮按钮吗？
faq.a: 可以。使用面板中的“Enable floating download button”开关即可关闭，之后也可随时重新启用。

zh-CN.safety: 脚本申请的权限仅限于打开标签页、添加样式以及读写用户脚本存储。当你触发下载时，当前页面网址（以及依据浏览器语言选择的语言路径）会被发送到外部下载服务；除此之外不会发送任何内容。面板通信通道会按预期的来源（origin）与来源窗口校验消息并去重；脚本不会访问你的 YouTube 账号或凭据。运行日志仅保存在内存缓冲区中（上限 200 条，刷新即清空），既不脱敏也不持久化，因此会话期间可能包含页面错误信息。

en.summary: ClipSaver for TikTok is a userscript that adds a floating download button over TikTok video players. Hover the pointer over a video to reveal the button, then click it to open an external download service preloaded with the current clip's URL. A companion panel page can control the button's appearance and trigger downloads, reporting progress back to the page.
en.problem: TikTok does not offer a straightforward way to save a clip to disk, and locating the current video's URL or ID by hand is inconvenient. This script surfaces a one-click download entry point directly on the player.
en.audience: TikTok viewers on desktop browsers who use a userscript manager (such as Tampermonkey or Violentmonkey) and want a quick way to hand the current clip to a download service.
highlights: The floating circular download button appears only while the pointer is over a video player, so normal browsing stays unobstructed.
Works with TikTok's xgplayer containers and falls back to standard video elements.
Button placement adapts to the page: profile pages use bottom-center, while video pages use top-center or right-three-quarter depending on the layout.
Button size, icon size, edge offset, and any of twelve preset positions are configurable.
Resolves the current clip's numeric video ID from the player element and builds a canonical video URL, falling back to the page URL without its query string.
An optional companion panel page can enable or disable the button, adjust settings, and start downloads, with running/done/error progress reporting.
Sends the browser language to the download service so its page opens in a matching locale.
A rainbow ring animation gives visual feedback when hovering the button.
usage: Install the script in a userscript manager and make sure it is enabled for tiktok.com.
Open TikTok in the browser; the script runs automatically as the page loads.
Move the pointer over a playing video to reveal the floating download button.
Click the button; the external download service opens in a new tab with the current clip's URL.
Optionally open the companion panel page to change the button position or size, toggle the button on or off, or start a download directly.
On the first run the script connects to its companion panel page once; the connection is remembered so it is not opened again automatically.
limitations: It matches tiktok.com pages only; it does not work on other sites or on non-TikTok embedded players.
The script is declared with @noframes, so it does not run inside iframes.
The actual download is performed by an external third-party service; the script only launches it and cannot guarantee service availability or the resulting file.
The button only appears over players that pass its size and visibility checks (for example, video readyState >= 3), so very small or not-yet-ready players may not show it.
It needs a userscript manager that supports the declared GM_* APIs; without them, opening tabs falls back to window.open and storage falls back to localStorage.
Panel communication relies on cross-origin postMessage/BroadcastChannel; if the companion page is unavailable, only the on-page button works.

faq.q: Does the script download videos by itself?
faq.a: No. It identifies the current clip's URL and opens an external download service in a new tab; the actual download is performed there.

faq.q: Where does the button appear?
faq.a: It appears only while the pointer is over a recognized video player, positioned according to the current TikTok page type and your configured position.

faq.q: Can I change the button's size or position?
faq.a: Yes, through the companion panel (button size, icon size, edge offset, and twelve preset positions), or by editing the defaults.

faq.q: Does it collect my personal data?
faq.a: The script stores only a small flag for the one-time panel connection and keeps runtime logs in memory; it does not read account credentials. The current clip URL is passed to the external download service when you click.

faq.q: Why don't I see the button?
faq.a: Make sure the script is enabled for tiktok.com, the video is playing or ready, and the player is large enough; moving the pointer directly over the player should reveal it.

faq.q: Does it work in iframes?
faq.a: No, the script is declared @noframes and runs only in the top-level TikTok page.

en.safety: The script runs only on tiktok.com and reads the current page and player to determine the clip URL. When you click the button (or trigger a panel download action), that URL is sent to an external download service in a new tab; nothing is downloaded without your click. Runtime logs (errors and message events) are kept only in a 200-entry in-memory buffer, are not redacted, and are cleared on reload; they are not stored persistently. The only persisted value is a one-time flag indicating the companion panel was connected, kept via userscript storage when available and otherwise in localStorage. The panel bridge trusts cross-origin messages only from the companion panel origin and the current page origin, plus a window reference obtained from window.open; no account credentials or passwords are read or transmitted.

en.summary: ClipSaver for Douyin adds a download button to the Douyin (douyin.com) video player control bar. Clicking it opens an external download launcher pre-filled with the URL of the current video. A companion control panel page can also trigger a download for the current video and shows the running state of each action.
en.problem: The Douyin web player has no built-in control to save the video you are currently watching. This script adds an in-player download button that forwards the current page URL to an external download service, so you do not have to copy the link manually.
en.audience: Desktop browser users who watch videos on douyin.com, already run a userscript manager, and want a quick one-click way to send the current video to a download service.
highlights: Injects a download button into the Douyin player control bar, styled to blend with the existing controls.
Clicking the button opens an external downloader page pre-filled with the current video URL.
Periodically rescans the player DOM so the button is re-added after the page or player re-renders.
Optional companion control panel can trigger a download of the current video on demand.
The panel can enable or disable the injected button and change the scan interval.
Reports each panel action's progress, completion, or error back to the panel.
Captures uncaught page errors and unhandled promise rejections into an in-memory log for troubleshooting.
Runs at document-start and only activates on douyin.com pages.
usage: Install a userscript manager in your browser, then add this script.
Open any video page on douyin.com.
Wait for the download button to appear in the player control bar (scanning runs every 777 ms by default).
Click the download button to open the external downloader for the current video.
Optionally open the companion panel to toggle the injected button or adjust the scan interval.
In the panel, use "Download current video" to trigger a download, or "Open download service" to open the downloader directly.
limitations: Works only on douyin.com and is disabled inside frames (@noframes).
It does not download the video itself: the actual download is performed by the external download service, and success depends on that service and on the video being available.
Because the button is re-injected by periodic scanning, it may briefly disappear and reappear when the player re-renders.
The companion panel is auto-opened only once (a stored flag prevents automatic reconnection on later visits).
Logs are kept in memory only (up to 200 entries) and are cleared when the page is refreshed; they are not persisted.
The button is cloned from the existing fullscreen control, so its placement may not match every player layout.

faq.q: Which sites does this script work on?
faq.a: Only Douyin web pages on douyin.com. It checks the host before activating and does nothing elsewhere.

faq.q: Does the script download the video by itself?
faq.a: No. It sends the current video's URL to an external download service; the downloading and file handling are done there.

faq.q: Can I turn the injected button off?
faq.a: Yes. The companion panel has an on/off switch for the injected download button and a field for the scan interval.

faq.q: Where are my settings and the logs stored?
faq.a: Settings and the panel-connection flag are saved through the userscript storage API, falling back to localStorage. Logs live only in memory and are cleared on refresh.

en.safety: The script runs only on douyin.com pages and reads the current page URL to pass it to the external download service. It requests the userscript grants GM_openInTab / GM.openInTab / GM_addStyle / GM_setValue / GM_getValue and stores a small panel-connection flag plus panel settings. It communicates with the companion panel over postMessage and BroadcastChannel and accepts messages only from the panel's own origin, ignoring other sources. It does not read or transmit page content beyond the current URL, and its diagnostic log is held in memory only, not persisted or uploaded. The downloader and panel pages are third-party external pages; review their own privacy practices before use.

en.summary: ClipSaver for Threads is a userscript that adds a download button to Threads posts containing video. Clicking it opens a companion download launcher for the selected post, and an optional panel page can trigger downloads and display progress.
en.problem: Threads offers no convenient built-in way to save videos from posts, so users must copy a post link and open an external service by hand. This script places a download entry point directly on each video post.
en.audience: Threads users on desktop browsers who run a userscript manager and want a fast way to hand video posts to an external download service.
highlights: Injects a download button beside the action buttons of Threads posts that contain video.
Resolves the canonical post link and opens a language-aware download launcher for it.
Provides an optional companion panel page that can trigger downloads and show running/done/failed progress.
Panel controls expose a scan interval for how often the page is re-scanned for new posts.
Falls back gracefully between GM storage and localStorage for saved settings.
Includes an in-memory runtime log that the panel can pull for diagnostics.
Connects the panel once per browser profile to avoid repeatedly opening tabs.
usage: Install a userscript manager and add the script.
Open threads.com or threads.net and browse posts that contain video.
Click the download icon added beside the post's action buttons.
The script opens the download launcher for that post in a new tab.
Optionally open the companion panel page to trigger a download for the current post or adjust the scan interval.
limitations: Only posts that contain a video element receive the download button; text- or image-only posts are skipped.
The script does not download or store videos itself; it hands the post URL to an external download service.
Only works on threads.com and threads.net.
Requires a userscript manager that supports GM_openInTab/GM.openInTab; the panel connection is attempted once and remembered per profile.

faq.q: Where does the video actually get downloaded?
faq.a: The script opens an external download service in a new tab and passes it the post URL; the actual retrieval happens there, not inside the script.

faq.q: Why don't I see a button on some posts?
faq.a: The button is only added to posts that contain video. Posts without a video element are ignored.

faq.q: Do I need to log in or give the script an account?
faq.a: No. The script only adds the button and opens the launcher; it does not collect accounts or credentials.

faq.q: What does the panel page do?
faq.a: It can request a download for the current post and shows progress states such as running, done and failed.

en.safety: The script requests the userscript manager permissions GM_openInTab/GM.openInTab, GM_addStyle, GM_setValue and GM_getValue. When a download is triggered, the URL of the current post is sent to the external download service so it can process the request. Runtime logs are held only in an in-memory ring buffer (maximum 200 entries) and are cleared on reload; they are not persisted or uploaded. Panel messages are origin-checked and accepted only from the trusted panel origin and the script's own page. Saved settings use GM storage with a localStorage fallback.

zh-CN.summary: ClipSaver for Threads 是一款用户脚本，会为包含视频的 Threads 帖子添加一个下载按钮。点击后会针对该帖子打开配套的下载启动器，可选的配套面板页也可以触发下载并显示进度。
zh-CN.problem: Threads 本身没有便捷的一键保存帖子视频的方式，用户只能手动复制帖子链接再打开外部服务。本脚本把下载入口直接放在每个视频帖子上。
zh-CN.audience: 在桌面浏览器上使用用户脚本管理器、希望快速把视频帖子交给外部下载服务的 Threads 用户。
highlights: 为包含视频的 Threads 帖子在操作按钮旁注入下载按钮。
解析帖子的规范链接，并按界面语言打开对应的下载启动器。
提供可选的配套面板页，可触发下载并显示运行中/完成/失败进度。
面板控件可调整重新扫描页面的间隔时间。
保存设置时在 GM 存储与 localStorage 之间自动回退。
内置内存运行日志，面板可按需拉取用于排查。
每个浏览器配置文件只连接一次面板，避免重复打开标签页。
usage: 安装用户脚本管理器并添加本脚本。
打开 threads.com 或 threads.net，浏览包含视频的帖子。
点击帖子操作按钮旁新增的下载图标。
脚本会在新标签页中为该帖子打开下载启动器。
（可选）打开配套面板页，为当前帖子触发下载或调整扫描间隔。
limitations: 只有包含 video 元素的帖子才会出现下载按钮，纯文字或纯图片帖子会被跳过。
脚本本身不下载或保存视频，而是把帖子链接交给外部下载服务处理。
仅支持 threads.com 与 threads.net。
需要支持 GM_openInTab/GM.openInTab 的用户脚本管理器；面板连接每个配置文件只尝试并记录一次。

faq.q: 视频最终在哪里下载？
faq.a: 脚本会在新标签页中打开外部下载服务并传入帖子链接，实际下载由该服务完成，而非脚本内部。

faq.q: 为什么有些帖子没有按钮？
faq.a: 按钮只添加到包含视频的帖子；没有 video 元素的帖子会被忽略。

faq.q: 需要登录或向脚本提供账号吗？
faq.a: 不需要。脚本只添加按钮并打开启动器，不会收集账号或凭据。

faq.q: 配套面板页有什么作用？
faq.a: 它可以为当前帖子请求下载，并显示运行中、完成、失败等进度状态。

zh-CN.safety: 脚本会申请用户脚本管理器的 GM_openInTab/GM.openInTab、GM_addStyle、GM_setValue 与 GM_getValue 权限。触发下载时，当前帖子的链接会发送给外部下载服务以便处理请求。运行日志仅保存在内存环形缓冲中（最多 200 条），刷新即清空，不会持久化或上传。面板消息会校验来源，仅接受可信面板来源与脚本所在页面。保存的设置使用 GM 存储，并以 localStorage 作为回退。

en.summary: ClipSaver for X adds a one-click download control to posts and media grids on X (formerly Twitter). Each control passes the selected post link to an external download launcher opened in a new tab, and a companion panel page can trigger downloads and show progress. Panel switches let you enable or disable the injected control and automatically reveal sensitive media.
en.problem: Downloading media from an X post normally means copying the post link by hand and switching to a separate download tool. ClipSaver for X places a download button directly in the post action bar and on media grid tiles, so the post link reaches a download launcher in a single click.
en.audience: X / Twitter users who frequently save images or videos and want a quick in-feed download shortcut, including people on the standard web timeline or TweetDeck-style layouts.
highlights: Adds a download control to the action bar of every post that contains media.
Adds a compact download button to media grid tiles, such as profile or search grids.
Opens a download launcher for the specific post in a new browser tab.
Companion panel page with switches to enable/disable the injected control and auto-reveal sensitive media.
Panel actions to download the current post or open the download service.
Optional automatic reveal of sensitive or age-restricted media before download.
Selects the downloader language from your browser language.
Lightweight companion-panel messaging with heartbeat, request/response and de-duplication.
usage: Install the userscript; it runs automatically on x.com and twitter.com.
Open a post that contains media, or a media grid.
Click the download control that appears next to the post actions or on the media tile.
The script opens the download launcher for that post in a new tab.
On first run a companion panel page opens; use its switches to enable/disable the injected control and toggle sensitive-media reveal.
Use the panel's Download current post / Open download service actions when needed.
limitations: The script does not download files itself; it hands the post link to an external download service opened in a new tab.
It depends on X's current page structure, so interface changes can temporarily break button injection.
The download control is only added to posts that contain media.
The companion panel and its live progress/log features require network access to the panel service.
In-page run logs exist only in memory, are cleared on refresh, and are not desensitized.
Media whose post link cannot be detected, such as some TweetDeck items, may not receive a button.

faq.q: Does the script download the media itself?
faq.a: No. It opens an external download launcher with the post link; the actual download is performed by that service.

faq.q: Which sites does it work on?
faq.a: It matches x.com and twitter.com and runs in the top frame only.

faq.q: Can I turn the injected button off?
faq.a: Yes. The companion panel provides an 'Enable injected download control' switch.

faq.q: Why did a panel page open?
faq.a: On first run the script opens its companion panel once and records that it has connected; the panel hosts the switches and download actions.

faq.q: Will it reveal sensitive media?
faq.a: Only if the 'Auto reveal sensitive media' switch is on (on by default); you can disable it.

faq.q: Where are settings and logs stored?
faq.a: Settings use the userscript manager's GM storage with a localStorage fallback; run logs stay in memory and clear on refresh.

en.safety: The script requests GM_openInTab, GM_setValue/GM_getValue and GM_addStyle. It stores only a small connection flag and your panel preferences via GM storage, falling back to localStorage; no credentials are collected. In-page run logs are kept in memory only, are not persisted and are not desensitized, and are shared only with the companion panel. Panel communication is restricted to the panel's own origin and the opener window reference, with message de-duplication. The external download service receives the URL of the post you choose to download, so only trigger downloads for content you intend to fetch.

在媒体网格单元（如个人主页或搜索网格）添加紧凑的下载按钮。
在新标签页中为该帖子打开下载启动页。
配套面板页提供启用/停用注入控件、自动展开敏感媒体的开关。

打开一条含媒体的帖子或媒体网格。
点击出现在帖子操作栏旁或媒体单元上的下载控件。

faq.q: 为什么打开了一个面板页？
faq.a: 首次运行时脚本会打开一次配套面板并记录已连接；面板承载开关和下载操作。

en.summary: ClipSaver for Instagram is a userscript that adds a floating, circular download button over Instagram videos, reels and posts. When you hover the mouse over a media element, the button appears and clicking it opens a download launcher for the current media in a new tab. A companion panel page can adjust the button and trigger downloads directly.
en.problem: Instagram does not provide a convenient, built-in way to save a video, reel or post while you are browsing it. ClipSaver puts a one-click download control right on top of the media you are already looking at, so you do not have to copy links or look for a separate tool.
en.audience: Instagram users who regularly view or keep videos, reels and posts and want a fast way to send the current media to a download service. It is intended for personal, everyday browsing on desktop browsers that support userscripts.
highlights: A floating circular download button appears automatically when you hover a video, reel or post, and hides when you move away from media.
Works across the Instagram feed, reel pages and post pages on instagram.com.
Resolves the media link from the post's own /p/, /reels/ or /reel/ link and falls back to the current page URL.
Opens the download launcher in a new tab, with the interface language matched to your browser (including English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese, among many others).
A companion control panel can enable or disable the button and adjust its position (12 presets), button size, icon size and edge offset.
The panel can also trigger "download current media" and "open download service" actions and reports running, done and error progress.
Panel communication runs over both postMessage and BroadcastChannel with message deduplication and a ping/pong heartbeat.
Built-in diagnostic log keeps the most recent events (including uncaught errors) for the panel to pull, while settings are saved via userscript storage with a localStorage fallback.
usage: Install the script with a userscript manager.
Open instagram.com, such as the feed, a reel or a post page.
Move the mouse over a video, reel or post; a circular download button appears over the media.
Click the button to open the download launcher for that media in a new tab.
Open the companion panel page to change the button position, size, icon size and edge offset, or to disable the button entirely.
Use the panel's action buttons to download the current media or to open the download service.
limitations: The script only runs on instagram.com; other websites are not affected.
The button appears only when the mouse hovers a sufficiently large, visible media element, and a video must already be loaded before it is detected.
The script does not download files itself; it passes the media URL to an external download service, so results and availability depend on that service.
The companion panel is a separate page opened as a popup, which browsers or popup blockers may block.
The panel connection is attempted once per installation rather than on every visit.
Diagnostic logs are kept in memory only, are cleared on refresh and are not redacted.

faq.q: Why doesn't the download button appear?
faq.a: The button is intentionally shown only while the mouse hovers a media element that is large enough and visible, and a video must have loaded first. Make sure you are on instagram.com and hover directly over a video, reel or post.

faq.q: Does the script download the file by itself?
faq.a: No. It detects the current media URL and opens an external download launcher in a new tab; the actual download is handled by that service.

faq.q: Where are my button settings stored?
faq.a: Settings such as enabled state, position, size and offsets are saved through the userscript manager's storage, with the browser's localStorage used as a fallback.

faq.q: Does it work on websites other than Instagram?
faq.a: No. The script is scoped to instagram.com and does nothing elsewhere.

faq.q: What language will the download launcher use?
faq.a: It follows your browser language and supports English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and many other languages, defaulting to English when the language is not recognized.

faq.q: Nothing happens when I click the button or open the panel.
faq.a: A popup blocker may be preventing the new tab from opening, or the external download service may be temporarily unavailable. Allow popups for the site and try again.

en.safety: The script requests GM_openInTab, GM.openInTab, GM_addStyle, GM_setValue and GM_getValue, reads navigator.language and the current media URL, and stores only its own button settings locally through userscript storage with a localStorage fallback. Panel messages are accepted only from the trusted panel origin and from the panel or opener window, and duplicate messages are discarded. Diagnostic logs may include page URLs and error details but stay in memory only, are never persisted and are not redacted; the only data sent externally is the media URL handed to the download service. It does not modify Instagram content and does not access your account credentials.

en.summary: ClipSaver for XiaoHongShu is a userscript that overlays a download button on the media area of a XiaoHongShu note and hands the current note to an online download service. A companion panel page can trigger a download and display progress and runtime logs. It runs only on xiaohongshu.com.
en.problem: XiaoHongShu note pages do not provide a built-in way to save a note's media. This script puts a one-click download control on the note and connects it to an external download service, so you no longer have to copy the note URL and hunt for a downloader yourself.
en.audience: Users who browse notes on xiaohongshu.com and want a convenient way to hand the current note to a download service, and who are comfortable installing a userscript and letting it open the companion panel and download pages.
highlights: Adds a floating download button directly over the note's media container.
Downloads the note you are currently viewing without copying its URL.
Shows an animated rainbow hover ring with a built-in download icon; styling is injected only once.
Companion panel page with a scan-interval setting and download actions.
Panel actions report running / done / error status back to the panel.
Uses GM storage when available and falls back to localStorage.
Runs only on xiaohongshu.com and injects only on /explore/ note pages.
usage: Install the userscript in a userscript manager that supports GM_openInTab, GM_addStyle, GM_setValue and GM_getValue.
Open a XiaoHongShu note page under the /explore/ path.
Wait for the round download button to appear over the note media.
Click the button (or use "Download current note" in the panel) to open the download service for that note.
Open the companion panel to adjust the scan interval or trigger a download.
Check the panel status line to see running, done, or failed results.
limitations: Only operates on xiaohongshu.com; other sites are untouched.
Button injection depends on specific selectors (#noteContainer and .media-container) and on /explore/ note pages; layout or DOM changes may stop it working.
Actual downloading is performed by an external online service, so it requires network access and can fail if that service is unavailable.
The panel is opened with window.open on first run, which a popup blocker may prevent.
The panel's enable switch is written into the script config, but the script still injects the button whenever a note media container is found.
The injected button scans the page repeatedly at the configured interval (default 777 ms).

faq.q: Where does the button appear?
faq.a: It is injected into the media container of a XiaoHongShu note page, near the top-right of the media area.

faq.q: Does the script download the file itself?
faq.a: No. It passes the current note URL to an external download service, which performs the download.

faq.q: Can I close the button?
faq.a: You can adjust the scan interval in the companion panel; the panel's enable switch does not currently stop the button from being injected.

faq.q: What settings are stored?
faq.a: Only a one-time "panel connected" flag is persisted, using GM storage when available or localStorage otherwise.

en.safety: The script runs only on xiaohongshu.com and is marked @noframes, so it does not execute inside embedded frames. It requests GM_openInTab, GM_addStyle, GM_setValue and GM_getValue: opening tabs is used only to open the download service and the companion panel, styling is injected into the local page, and storage keeps only a one-time connection flag (falling back to localStorage). To complete a download, the current note URL is sent to the external download service. Panel messaging is scoped to a task channel, cross-origin messages are accepted only from the panel origin, and duplicate messages are de-duplicated. Runtime logs are kept in a small in-memory ring buffer (up to 200 entries) that is cleared on reload and is neither persisted nor redacted. The script does not read or transmit account credentials.

en.summary: ClipSaver for TED is a userscript that adds a circular download button to TED talk pages. Clicking the button hands the current talk's URL to a web-based download service, opened in a new tab. A companion control panel can turn the injected button on or off, trigger a download, and show progress.
en.problem: TED talk pages do not offer a built-in way to save a talk for offline use. This script adds a single, always-available download entry point to the talk page so you do not have to copy the URL and manually feed it to a download service.
en.audience: TED viewers who want a quick, one-click way to send the talk they are watching to a download service, and users who prefer managing this from a small control panel.
highlights: Injects a single circular download button into the action row of a TED talk page.
Opens a web-based download service for the current talk URL in a new tab.
Picks the download-service language path from the browser language.
Companion panel can enable or disable the injected button and trigger downloads.
Panel reports action status as connecting, running, done, or failed.
Re-injects the button automatically during in-page (SPA) navigation and on page load.
Keeps an in-memory runtime log and captures uncaught errors and promise rejections for troubleshooting.
Adds a rainbow hover ring effect to the button using injected styles.
usage: Install the userscript and open any talk page on www.ted.com/talks/.
Wait for the page to load; a circular download button appears in the talk's action row near the title.
Click the button to open the download service for the current talk in a new tab.
Optionally open the companion control panel to toggle the injected button or start a download from there.
Watch the panel status line for connecting, running, done, or failed feedback.
Navigate between talks normally; the button is re-injected automatically without a full reload.
limitations: Only runs on TED talk pages that match www.ted.com/talks/; other pages are unaffected.
Button injection depends on TED's current page structure (the talk title's action container), so a site redesign could break it.
The script itself does not download media; it delegates to an external web download service.
Only the current talk can be triggered; there is no bulk or playlist downloading.
The runtime log is kept in memory only and is cleared when the page is refreshed.
The companion panel is hosted on an external site and opens in a separate tab/window.

faq.q: Does the script download the video by itself?
faq.a: No. It sends the current talk URL to an external web-based download service, which handles the actual download in a separate tab.

faq.q: Which pages does the button appear on?
faq.a: Only talk pages matching www.ted.com/talks/. It does not run on other TED pages or other sites.

faq.q: Can I hide the button?
faq.a: Yes. The companion control panel provides an enable switch for the injected download button; turning it off stops the button from being inserted.

faq.q: Why does a panel page open?
faq.a: The script connects to a companion control panel the first time it runs so you can toggle the button and trigger downloads with status feedback. Connection is remembered via stored state.

faq.q: What is the runtime log for?
faq.a: It records script events, uncaught errors, and promise rejections in a small in-memory buffer to help diagnose problems. It is not persisted and clears on refresh.

en.safety: The script requests permissions to open tabs (GM_openInTab), inject styles (GM_addStyle), and read/write stored values (GM_getValue, GM_setValue). It stores only small state such as whether the panel connection has been made, falling back to localStorage if userscript storage is unavailable. Runtime logs are kept in memory only (a bounded ring buffer) and are not uploaded or persisted by the script. Clicking the download button passes the current page URL to an external download service, and the companion panel is loaded from an external site; communication with it is restricted to a trusted origin. The script does not access credentials or transmit personal data.

zh-CN.summary: ClipSaver for TED 是一款用户脚本，会在 TED 演讲页面注入一个圆形下载按钮。点击后会把当前演讲的网址交给一个网页版下载服务，并在新标签页中打开。配套的控制面板可以开启或关闭注入的按钮、触发下载并显示进度。
zh-CN.problem: TED 演讲页面本身没有提供离线保存的方式。本脚本在演讲页面上增加一个始终可用的下载入口，免去手动复制网址再交给下载服务的麻烦。
zh-CN.audience: 希望一键把正在观看的演讲发送到下载服务的 TED 观众，以及偏好用一个小控制面板来管理此功能的用户。
highlights: 在 TED 演讲页面的操作区注入一个圆形下载按钮。
为新标签页中的当前演讲网址打开网页版下载服务。
根据浏览器语言选择下载服务的语言路径。
配套面板可开启或关闭注入按钮并触发下载。
面板以 connecting、running、done、failed 状态反馈动作进度。
在页面内（SPA）跳转与页面加载时自动重新注入按钮。
保留内存中的运行日志，并捕获未处理错误与 Promise 拒绝，便于排查问题。
通过注入样式为按钮添加彩虹描边悬停效果。
usage: 安装该用户脚本，并打开 www.ted.com/talks/ 下的任意演讲页面。
等待页面加载，标题附近的演讲操作区会出现一个圆形下载按钮。
点击按钮，在新标签页中为当前演讲打开下载服务。
可选：打开配套控制面板，从那里切换注入按钮或启动下载。
查看面板状态行，获取 connecting、running、done 或 failed 反馈。
正常在演讲之间跳转，按钮会自动重新注入，无需整页刷新。
limitations: 仅在匹配 www.ted.com/talks/ 的 TED 演讲页面运行，其他页面不受影响。
按钮注入依赖 TED 当前的页面结构（演讲标题的操作容器），站点改版可能导致失效。
脚本本身不下载媒体文件，而是交给外部网页下载服务完成。
只能触发当前演讲，不支持批量或播放列表下载。
运行日志仅保存在内存中，页面刷新后会被清空。
配套面板由外部站点托管，会在单独的标签页或窗口中打开。

faq.q: 脚本会自己下载视频吗？
faq.a: 不会。它把当前演讲网址发送给一个外部网页下载服务，由该服务在单独的标签页中完成实际下载。

faq.q: 按钮会出现在哪些页面？
faq.a: 只会出现在匹配 www.ted.com/talks/ 的演讲页面，不会在其他 TED 页面或站点运行。

faq.q: 我可以隐藏这个按钮吗？
faq.a: 可以。配套控制面板提供注入下载按钮的启用开关，关闭后按钮将不再被插入。

faq.q: 为什么会自动打开一个面板页面？
faq.a: 脚本首次运行时会连接一个配套控制面板，便于切换按钮并带状态反馈地触发下载。连接状态会被记住。

faq.q: 运行日志有什么用？
faq.a: 它在一个小的内存缓冲区中记录脚本事件、未处理错误与 Promise 拒绝，用于帮助诊断问题。日志不会被持久化，刷新即清空。

zh-CN.safety: 脚本申请了打开标签页（GM_openInTab）、注入样式（GM_addStyle）以及读写存储值（GM_getValue、GM_setValue）的权限。它只保存少量状态（例如是否已建立面板连接），在用户脚本存储不可用时回退到 localStorage。运行日志仅保存在内存中（有上限的环形缓冲），脚本不会上传或持久化这些日志。点击下载按钮会把当前页面网址交给外部下载服务，配套面板也从外部站点加载；与其通信仅限受信任来源。脚本不会访问凭据，也不会传输个人数据。

en.summary: ClipSaver adds a floating circular download button that appears when you hover over a video on Pinterest or Snapchat. Clicking it forwards the current item's page URL to an external download launcher. A companion panel page can also toggle the button, trigger downloads and show progress.
en.problem: Saving a Pinterest pin or Snapchat video normally means finding the media source, copying its URL and pasting it into a separate downloader site. This script puts a one-click button directly over the video you are watching and passes the current item's URL to a download service for you.
en.audience: Desktop-browser users who often save videos from Pinterest or Snapchat and want a faster, one-click path to a downloader. Suitable for users who already use a userscript manager such as Tampermonkey.
highlights: Adds a floating circular download button that appears on hover over playable videos on Pinterest and Snapchat.
One click sends the current item's page URL (or its pin link on Pinterest) to an external download launcher.
On Snapchat the button stays active only on supported story, Spotlight and /p/ item URLs while you navigate.
Configurable button position (12 presets), button size, icon size and edge offset.
A companion panel page can enable/disable the button and trigger "download current item" or "open download service".
The panel reports running, done and error status while the script streams its in-memory logs to it.
Follows Pinterest and Snapchat single-page navigation by watching history and hash changes.
usage: Install a userscript manager, then install this script so its @match rules apply to pinterest.com and snapchat.com.
Open a Pinterest pin or a Snapchat story, Spotlight or /p/ item that contains a video.
Hover the mouse over the video; a circular download button appears over the player.
Click the button to open the external download service with the current item pre-filled.
Optionally open the companion panel page to control the button and trigger downloads remotely.
In the panel, adjust enable/disable, button position, button size, icon size and edge offset, then run "download current item" or "open download service".
limitations: The actual download is handled by a third-party external service; the script only forwards the item URL and does not download the media itself.
Only Pinterest and Snapchat are supported, and the button targets <video> elements above a minimum size, so images and unsupported media are ignored.
The button appears only when the pointer is over a visible, sufficiently loaded video.
The companion panel is opened only once per browser profile; a stored flag suppresses later automatic openings.
If the userscript manager's storage is unavailable, configuration falls back to localStorage on each matching site.
The downloader address is built from the detected browser language, and only a fixed set of languages is mapped.

faq.q: Does the script download the video by itself?
faq.a: No. It shows a button that forwards the current item's URL to an external download service, which performs the actual download.

faq.q: Why doesn't the button appear?
faq.a: It appears only when the pointer is over a visible video of at least the minimum size that is loaded enough; on Snapchat it also requires a supported story, Spotlight or item URL.

faq.q: What does the companion panel page do?
faq.a: It lets you enable or disable the button, change its position, button size, icon size and edge offset, and trigger "download current item" or "open download service", while showing running, done or error progress.

faq.q: Is anything stored on my computer?
faq.a: Only your button/panel preferences and a one-time "panel opened" flag, saved through the userscript manager's storage with localStorage as a fallback.

en.safety: On click or via a panel action, the script reads the current page URL and opens an external download service with that URL encoded in the query string, so the address of the item you are viewing is shared with that third party. It also loads a companion panel page from an external origin and exchanges messages with it, ignoring messages whose origin is neither the panel origin nor the current page. Preferences are stored through the userscript manager's storage, falling back to localStorage. A running log is kept only in memory, is not persisted and is cleared on refresh; it is not sanitized and may contain page URLs and error details. The script does not collect credentials and does not modify page content beyond adding its own button.

zh-CN.summary: ClipSaver 会在 Pinterest 和 Snapchat 的视频上显示一个悬浮的圆形下载按钮，鼠标悬停时出现。点击后会把当前条目的页面地址发送到外部下载启动器。配套面板页还可以开关按钮、触发下载并显示进度。
zh-CN.problem: 保存 Pinterest 的 Pin 或 Snapchat 视频通常需要先找到媒体源、复制地址，再粘贴到单独的下载站点。本脚本在你正在观看的视频上直接放置一键按钮，并自动把当前条目的地址交给下载服务。
zh-CN.audience: 经常在桌面浏览器上保存 Pinterest 或 Snapchat 视频、希望一键跳转到下载器的用户。适合已经使用 Tampermonkey 等用户脚本管理器的用户。
highlights: 在 Pinterest 和 Snapchat 的可播放视频上，悬停时显示悬浮的圆形下载按钮。
点击一次即可把当前条目的页面地址（Pinterest 上优先取其 Pin 链接）发送到外部下载启动器。
在 Snapchat 上，按钮只在受支持的故事、Spotlight 和 /p/ 条目地址中随导航保持可用。
可配置按钮位置（12 种预设）、按钮尺寸、图标尺寸和边缘间距。
配套面板页可开关按钮，并触发“下载当前条目”或“打开下载服务”。
面板可显示运行中、已完成和错误状态，脚本会向其推送内存中的运行日志。
通过监听 history 与 hash 变化，适配 Pinterest 和 Snapchat 的单页导航。
usage: 先安装用户脚本管理器，再安装本脚本，使其 @match 规则作用于 pinterest.com 和 snapchat.com。
打开包含视频的 Pinterest Pin，或 Snapchat 故事、Spotlight、/p/ 条目。
将鼠标悬停在视频上，播放器上会出现一个圆形下载按钮。
点击该按钮，外部下载服务会带着当前条目信息打开。
可选：打开配套面板页，远程控制按钮并触发下载。
在面板中调整开关、按钮位置、按钮尺寸、图标尺寸和边缘间距，然后执行“下载当前条目”或“打开下载服务”。
limitations: 实际下载由第三方外部服务完成；脚本只转发条目地址，本身不下载媒体。
仅支持 Pinterest 和 Snapchat，且按钮只针对超过最小尺寸的 <video> 元素，图片和不受支持的媒体会被忽略。
只有指针位于可见且已充分加载的视频上时，按钮才会出现。
配套面板在每个浏览器配置中只会自动打开一次；已存储的标记会阻止后续自动打开。
若用户脚本管理器的存储不可用，配置会在各匹配站点回退到 localStorage。
下载器地址根据检测到的浏览器语言拼接，且只映射了固定的一组语言。

faq.q: 脚本会自己下载视频吗？
faq.a: 不会。它显示一个按钮，把当前条目的地址转发给外部下载服务，由该服务完成实际下载。

faq.q: 为什么按钮不出现？
faq.a: 只有当指针位于可见、尺寸达标且已充分加载的视频上时才会出现；在 Snapchat 上还需要处于受支持的故事、Spotlight 或条目地址。

faq.q: 配套面板页有什么作用？
faq.a: 可开关按钮，调整其位置、按钮尺寸、图标尺寸和边缘间距，并触发“下载当前条目”或“打开下载服务”，同时显示运行中、已完成或错误进度。

faq.q: 我的数据会被保存在哪里？
faq.a: 只保存你的按钮/面板偏好以及一次性的“面板已打开”标记，通过用户脚本管理器的存储保存，回退方案为 localStorage。

zh-TW.problem: 儲存 Pinterest 的 Pin 或 Snapchat 影片，通常得先找到媒體來源、複製位址，再貼到另一個下載網站。本腳本會在你正在觀看的影片上直接放置一鍵按鈕，並自動把目前項目的位址交給下載服務。

highlights: 在 Pinterest 與 Snapchat 的可播放影片上，懸停時顯示懸浮的圓形下載按鈕。
點擊一次即可把目前項目的頁面位址（Pinterest 上優先取其 Pin 連結）送往外部下載啟動器。
在 Snapchat 上，按鈕只在支援的限時動態、Spotlight 與 /p/ 項目位址中隨導覽保持可用。
可設定按鈕位置（12 種預設）、按鈕尺寸、圖示尺寸與邊緣間距。
搭配的面板頁可開關按鈕，並觸發「下載目前項目」或「開啟下載服務」。
面板可顯示執行中、已完成與錯誤狀態，腳本會向其推送記憶體中的執行紀錄。
透過監聽 history 與 hash 變化，相容 Pinterest 與 Snapchat 的單頁導覽。

開啟包含影片的 Pinterest Pin，或 Snapchat 限時動態、Spotlight、/p/ 項目。
將滑鼠懸停在影片上，播放器上會出現一個圓形下載按鈕。
點擊該按鈕，外部下載服務會帶著目前項目資訊開啟。
可選：開啟搭配的面板頁，遠端控制按鈕並觸發下載。
在面板中調整開關、按鈕位置、按鈕尺寸、圖示尺寸與邊緣間距，然後執行「下載目前項目」或「開啟下載服務」。
limitations: 實際下載由第三方外部服務完成；腳本只轉送項目位址，本身不下載媒體。
僅支援 Pinterest 與 Snapchat，且按鈕只針對超過最小尺寸的 <video> 元素，圖片與不受支援的媒體會被忽略。
只有指標位於可見且已充分載入的影片上時，按鈕才會出現。
搭配的面板在每個瀏覽器設定中只會自動開啟一次；已儲存的標記會阻止後續自動開啟。

下載器位址依偵測到的瀏覽器語言拼接，且只對應了固定的一組語言。

faq.q: 腳本會自己下載影片嗎？
faq.a: 不會。它顯示一個按鈕，把目前項目的位址轉送給外部下載服務，由該服務完成實際下載。

faq.q: 為什麼按鈕不出現？
faq.a: 只有當指標位於可見、尺寸達標且已充分載入的影片上時才會出現；在 Snapchat 上還需要處於支援的限時動態、Spotlight 或項目位址。

faq.q: 搭配的面板頁有什麼作用？
faq.a: 可開關按鈕，調整其位置、按鈕尺寸、圖示尺寸與邊緣間距，並觸發「下載目前項目」或「開啟下載服務」，同時顯示執行中、已完成或錯誤進度。

faq.q: 我的資料會被儲存在哪裡？
faq.a: 只儲存你的按鈕/面板偏好以及一次性的「面板已開啟」標記，透過使用者腳本管理員的儲存空間儲存，回退方案為 localStorage。

zh-TW.safety: 在點擊按鈕或透過面板操作時，腳本會讀取目前頁面位址，並以查詢參數形式（經編碼）開啟外部下載服務，因此你正在檢視的項目位址會分享給該第三方。腳本也會從外部來源載入搭配的面板頁並與其交換訊息，只接受來自面板來源或目前頁面來源的訊息，忽略其它來源。偏好設定透過使用者腳本管理員的儲存空間儲存，回退方案為 localStorage。執行紀錄僅保存在記憶體中，不會持久化，重新整理即清空；紀錄未經去識別化處理，可能包含頁面位址與錯誤資訊。腳本不蒐集帳號憑證，除加入自身按鈕外不修改頁面內容。

en.summary: ClipSaver for Spotify is a userscript that adds a download button to the Spotify web player and to tracks in track lists. Clicking a button opens an external audio download service for that track in a new tab. An optional companion panel page can toggle the buttons and trigger a download for the current track.
en.problem: On the Spotify web player there is no convenient way to jump from the track you are viewing to an audio download service. This script adds a one-click button on the player and on each track row so you do not have to copy the track link and paste it into another site manually.
en.audience: Spotify web player users who frequently want to fetch an audio file for the track they are playing or browsing and prefer a single-click shortcut over manually copying links.
highlights: Injects a download button into the Spotify web player next to the existing player controls.
Adds a matching download button to each row in track lists.
Clicking a button opens an external audio download service for that specific track in a new tab.
Detects the track automatically from the page or the clicked row, so no manual link copy is needed.
Companion panel page can enable or disable the injected buttons and set the track list icon size.
Panel page can also trigger a download for the current track and shows running/done/failed status.
Re-scans the page automatically so buttons appear on dynamically loaded content.
Remembers the connection state so the panel is not reopened on every page load.
usage: Install the userscript in a userscript manager and open https://open.spotify.com in your browser.
Start playing or browsing a track; a download button appears in the player controls.
Click the player button to open the audio download service for the current track in a new tab.
For a specific track in a list, click the download button on that track row.
Open the companion panel page (shown once on first run) to adjust settings.
In the panel, toggle 'Enable injected track buttons' or change the track list icon size as needed.
Use the panel actions to download the current track or open the download service directly.
limitations: Only runs on open.spotify.com; other Spotify pages or apps are not supported.
It relies on the Spotify web player's page structure, which can change and may temporarily break button injection.
The script only opens an external download service page; it does not download, decrypt, or store audio files itself.
Available audio formats and quality depend entirely on the external service, not on this script.
The panel is opened automatically only on the first run; afterwards it must be opened again through the script's own mechanism.
Very long or unusual track lists may take a moment to receive buttons while the page is rescanned.

faq.q: Does the script download the audio file itself?
faq.a: No. It only opens an external download service page for the track you selected; the actual download is handled by that service.

faq.q: Why don't I see the download button?
faq.a: The button is injected based on the web player's current layout. If Spotify changes its interface, or the player controls are not visible yet, the button may not appear until the page updates again.

faq.q: Can I turn the buttons off?
faq.a: Yes. The companion panel page has an 'Enable injected track buttons' switch that disables the injected buttons.

faq.q: Which pages are supported?
faq.a: Only the Spotify web player at open.spotify.com.

faq.q: How is my track selected?
faq.a: For the player button the script reads the currently displayed track; for track lists it reads the track from the row whose button you clicked.

en.safety: The script requests only the permissions it needs: opening a new tab (GM_openInTab), storing a small amount of settings data (GM_setValue/GM_getValue), and nothing else beyond the normal page context. It stores only a flag marking that the panel was already connected and the user's panel settings; no account credentials or personal data are collected or transmitted. Runtime logs are kept in an in-memory ring buffer only, are cleared on page reload, and are never persisted. When you click a download button, the track's public URL is sent to the external audio download service that opens in a new tab, so review that service's own privacy practices before using it.

highlights: 在 Spotify 网页播放器的播放控制区注入下载按钮。
为曲目列表中的每一行添加对应的下载按钮。
点击按钮会在新标签页中打开该曲目的外部音频下载服务。
自动从页面或所点击的行识别曲目，无需手动复制链接。
配套面板页可启用或禁用注入按钮，并设置曲目列表图标尺寸。

usage: 在用户脚本管理器中安装该脚本，并在浏览器中打开 https://open.spotify.com。
开始播放或浏览曲目，播放控制区会出现下载按钮。
点击播放器按钮，在新标签页中为当前曲目打开音频下载服务。
若要下载列表中的指定曲目，点击该曲目行上的下载按钮。
打开配套面板页（首次运行时会自动显示一次）以调整设置。
在面板中按需切换“启用注入的曲目按钮”或修改曲目列表图标尺寸。
使用面板操作直接下载当前曲目或打开下载服务。
limitations: 仅在 open.spotify.com 上运行，其他 Spotify 页面或应用不受支持。
依赖 Spotify 网页播放器的页面结构，若其改版，按钮注入可能暂时失效。
脚本只打开外部下载服务页面，本身不下载、不解密、也不存储音频文件。
可用的音频格式与音质完全取决于外部服务，而非本脚本。
面板仅在首次运行时自动打开，之后需通过脚本自身的机制再次打开。
特别长或结构异常的曲目列表在页面重新扫描时可能需要稍等片刻才会出现按钮。

faq.q: 脚本会自己下载音频文件吗？
faq.a: 不会。它只会为你选中的曲目打开外部下载服务页面，实际下载由该服务完成。

faq.a: 按钮的注入依赖网页播放器当前的布局。若 Spotify 更改了界面，或播放控制尚未可见，按钮可能要到页面再次更新时才出现。

faq.a: 可以。配套面板页中有“启用注入的曲目按钮”开关，可禁用注入的按钮。

faq.q: 支持哪些页面？
faq.a: 仅支持 open.spotify.com 上的 Spotify 网页播放器。

en.summary: ClipSaver Media File Downloader is a userscript that adds a one-click direct download panel to media file pages served from supported content CDNs. On video, audio and image pages it shows a small floating panel with Start Download and Cancel Download controls and a live progress bar. It fetches the current media URL as a blob and saves it locally, and a companion panel page can start or cancel downloads and toggle the on-page panel.
en.problem: Media served directly from CDN hosts often plays in the browser but gives you no obvious way to save the file, and right-click saving is unreliable or missing on such pages. This script adds a dedicated download panel so the current media file can be fetched and saved in one click, with visible progress and a cancel option.
en.audience: Users who regularly view video, audio or image files hosted on the supported media CDN domains and want a simple, repeatable way to save them, without needing separate downloader tools for each site.
highlights: Injects a floating download panel on supported media pages served from the covered CDN hosts.
One-click download of the current media file directly from its URL.
Live progress bar with percentage and downloaded/total size in bytes.
Cancel Download button to abort an in-progress download.
Toast notifications for completed, failed and canceled downloads.
On-page interface text follows the browser language, with 22 supported languages and English fallback.
A companion panel page can remotely start or cancel downloads and toggle whether the on-page panel appears.
Panel visibility setting is persisted, so the preference is remembered across visits.
usage: Install the userscript in a userscript manager that supports GM_xmlhttpRequest and the granted storage APIs.
Open a supported media file URL (video, audio or image) hosted on one of the covered CDN domains.
A small panel appears at the top-right of the page showing Start Download.
Click Start Download to begin; a progress bar shows percentage and transferred/total size.
Click Cancel Download at any time to stop the transfer.
After a download finishes, use Download Again to fetch it a second time.
Optionally use the companion panel page to start or cancel the download and to turn the on-page panel on or off.
limitations: Only runs on the explicitly listed media CDN host patterns and only when the page content type is not text/html; normal website pages are not covered.
The download is a single GET request of the current page URL, so it does not merge segmented HLS/DASH streams, and very large files may be better saved manually as noted in the on-panel tip.
If the on-page panel is turned off in the companion panel, no download controls are injected.
The script may open the companion panel page once on first connection; if the browser blocks pop-ups, that connection may not appear.
There is no pause/resume: canceling aborts the request and a new download starts from the beginning.
Downloaded files are named with a timestamp plus the detected extension, not the original title.

faq.q: Which pages does the download panel appear on?
faq.a: Only pages whose host matches the supported media CDN domains and whose content type is not text/html, such as a direct video, audio or image file URL.

faq.q: Where is the downloaded file saved?
faq.a: It is saved through the browser's normal download flow, so it goes to your browser's default download location with a generated filename.

faq.q: Can I pause and resume a download?
faq.a: No. Cancel Download aborts the request, and starting again re-downloads the file from the beginning.

faq.q: How is the file extension chosen?
faq.a: The script first checks an extension hint in the URL, then the MIME type of the page's video source or a type/URL match, and falls back to mp4.

faq.q: Can I hide the panel on media pages?
faq.a: Yes. The companion panel page provides a switch to show or hide the on-page download panel, and the setting is remembered.

faq.q: Does the script send my data anywhere?
faq.a: No. The download request goes to the current media URL itself, and runtime logs are kept only in memory for the panel view.

en.safety: The script requests the media file from the same URL you are already viewing, using the userscript manager's cross-origin request capability limited to the declared @connect hosts. It does not upload your files or browsing data to any third party. On-page and panel communication is restricted to the panel's own origin and the current page's origin. Runtime logs are held in a small in-memory ring buffer and are not persisted; only the panel visibility preference and connection flag are stored, via GM storage with a localStorage fallback. Downloading media may still be subject to the source site's terms, so use the script only where you have the right to save the content.

zh-CN.summary: ClipSaver Media File Downloader 是一款用户脚本，可在受支持的媒体 CDN 页面上一键直链下载媒体文件。在视频、音频和图片页面上，它会显示一个悬浮小面板，包含“开始下载”和“取消下载”按钮以及实时进度条。脚本会以 blob 方式抓取当前媒体地址并保存到本地，同时配套面板页可以启动或取消下载，并开关页面上的下载面板。
zh-CN.problem: 由 CDN 直接提供的媒体文件通常能在浏览器中播放，但页面上没有明显的保存入口，右键保存也往往不可用或不可靠。本脚本提供一个专用下载面板，让当前媒体文件可以一键抓取并保存，同时显示进度并支持取消。
zh-CN.audience: 经常在受支持的媒体 CDN 域名上查看视频、音频或图片文件，并希望用简单、可重复的方式保存这些文件的用户，无需为每个站点单独寻找下载工具。
highlights: 在受支持的媒体 CDN 页面上注入悬浮下载面板。
一键下载当前媒体文件，直接使用其地址抓取。
实时进度条，显示百分比以及已下载/总大小。
提供“取消下载”按钮，可中止进行中的下载。
下载完成、失败、取消时均有提示气泡。
页面文案跟随浏览器语言，支持 22 种语言，未支持语言回退到英文。
配套面板页可远程启动或取消下载，并开关页面上是否显示面板。
面板显示开关会被持久化保存，偏好可在后续访问中保留。
usage: 在支持 GM_xmlhttpRequest 及所声明存储接口的用户脚本管理器中安装本脚本。
打开受支持媒体 CDN 域名上的媒体文件地址（视频、音频或图片）。
页面右上角会出现小面板，显示“开始下载”按钮。
点击“开始下载”开始抓取，进度条会显示百分比以及已传输/总大小。
随时点击“取消下载”可停止传输。
下载完成后可用“重新下载”再次抓取。
可选：使用配套面板页启动或取消下载，并开启或关闭页面上的下载面板。
limitations: 仅在明确列出的媒体 CDN 主机规则下运行，且页面内容类型不能是 text/html；普通网页不在此范围内。
下载是对当前页面地址的一次 GET 请求，不会合并 HLS/DASH 分片流，且如面板提示所述，文件过大时更适合手动保存。
若在配套面板中关闭了页面面板，则不会注入任何下载控件。
首次连接时脚本可能会打开配套面板页；若浏览器拦截弹窗，可能看不到该连接。
没有暂停/续传：取消会中止请求，再次下载会从头开始。
保存的文件名由时间戳加检测到的扩展名组成，而非原始标题。

faq.q: 下载面板会出现在哪些页面上？
faq.a: 仅出现在主机匹配受支持媒体 CDN 域名、且内容类型不是 text/html 的页面上，例如直接的视频、音频或图片文件地址。

faq.q: 下载的文件保存在哪里？
faq.a: 文件通过浏览器常规下载流程保存，会存到你浏览器的默认下载位置，并使用生成的文件名。

faq.q: 可以暂停并续传吗？
faq.a: 不能。“取消下载”会中止请求，再次开始会从头重新下载。

faq.q: 文件扩展名是如何确定的？
faq.a: 脚本会先检查地址中的扩展名提示，其次检查页面视频源的 MIME 类型或类型/地址匹配，最后回退为 mp4。

faq.q: 可以隐藏页面上的面板吗？
faq.a: 可以。配套面板页提供开关，可显示或隐藏页面上的下载面板，且该设置会被记住。

faq.q: 脚本会把我的数据发送到别处吗？
faq.a: 不会。下载请求只发往当前媒体地址本身，运行日志仅保存在内存中供面板查看。

zh-CN.safety: 脚本仅使用用户脚本管理器受限的跨域请求能力，向你正在查看的同一媒体地址请求文件，并且只限访问脚本声明的 @connect 主机。它不会把你的文件或浏览数据上传给任何第三方。页面与面板之间的通信仅限面板自身的来源和当前页面的来源。运行日志保存在一个较小的内存环形缓冲中，不做持久化；只有面板显示偏好和连接标记会被保存，通过 GM 存储并在不可用时回退到 localStorage。下载媒体仍可能受来源站点条款约束，请仅在你有权保存内容时使用本脚本。

zh-TW.summary: ClipSaver Media File Downloader 是一款使用者腳本，可在受支援的媒體 CDN 頁面上以一鍵直連方式下載媒體檔案。在影片、音訊與圖片頁面上，它會顯示一個懸浮小面板，包含「開始下載」與「取消下載」按鈕以及即時進度條。腳本會以 blob 方式抓取目前媒體網址並儲存到本機，同時配套面板頁可以啟動或取消下載，並開關頁面上的下載面板。
zh-TW.problem: 由 CDN 直接提供的媒體檔案通常可在瀏覽器中播放，但頁面上沒有明顯的儲存入口，右鍵儲存也往往不可用或不可靠。本腳本提供專用下載面板，讓目前媒體檔案可以一鍵抓取並儲存，同時顯示進度並支援取消。
zh-TW.audience: 經常在受支援的媒體 CDN 網域上檢視影片、音訊或圖片檔案，並希望用簡單、可重複的方式儲存這些檔案的使用者，無需為每個網站單獨尋找下載工具。
highlights: 在受支援的媒體 CDN 頁面上注入懸浮下載面板。
一鍵下載目前媒體檔案，直接使用其網址抓取。
即時進度條，顯示百分比以及已下載/總大小。
提供「取消下載」按鈕，可中止進行中的下載。
下載完成、失敗、取消時均有提示氣泡。
頁面文案跟隨瀏覽器語言，支援 22 種語言，未支援語言回退為英文。
配套面板頁可遠端啟動或取消下載，並開關頁面上是否顯示面板。
面板顯示開關會被持久化保存，偏好可在後續造訪中保留。
usage: 在支援 GM_xmlhttpRequest 及所宣告儲存介面的使用者腳本管理器中安裝本腳本。
開啟受支援媒體 CDN 網域上的媒體檔案網址（影片、音訊或圖片）。
頁面右上角會出現小面板，顯示「開始下載」按鈕。
點擊「開始下載」開始抓取，進度條會顯示百分比以及已傳輸/總大小。
隨時點擊「取消下載」可停止傳輸。
下載完成後可用「重新下載」再次抓取。
選用：使用配套面板頁啟動或取消下載，並開啟或關閉頁面上的下載面板。
limitations: 僅在明確列出的媒體 CDN 主機規則下執行，且頁面內容類型不能是 text/html；一般網頁不在此範圍內。
下載是對目前頁面網址的一次 GET 請求，不會合併 HLS/DASH 分段串流，且如面板提示所述，檔案過大時更適合手動儲存。
若在配套面板中關閉了頁面面板，則不會注入任何下載控制項。
首次連線時腳本可能會開啟配套面板頁；若瀏覽器攔截彈出視窗，可能看不到該連線。
沒有暫停/續傳：取消會中止請求，再次下載會從頭開始。
儲存的檔案名稱由時間戳加偵測到的副檔名組成，而非原始標題。

faq.q: 下載面板會出現在哪些頁面上？
faq.a: 僅出現在主機符合受支援媒體 CDN 網域、且內容類型不是 text/html 的頁面上，例如直接的影片、音訊或圖片檔案網址。

faq.q: 下載的檔案儲存在哪裡？
faq.a: 檔案透過瀏覽器一般下載流程儲存，會存到你瀏覽器的預設下載位置，並使用產生的檔案名稱。

faq.q: 可以暫停並續傳嗎？
faq.a: 不能。「取消下載」會中止請求，再次開始會從頭重新下載。

faq.q: 檔案副檔名是如何決定的？
faq.a: 腳本會先檢查網址中的副檔名提示，其次檢查頁面影片來源的 MIME 類型或類型/網址比對，最後回退為 mp4。

faq.q: 可以隱藏頁面上的面板嗎？
faq.a: 可以。配套面板頁提供開關，可顯示或隱藏頁面上的下載面板，且該設定會被記住。

faq.q: 腳本會把我的資料傳送到別處嗎？
faq.a: 不會。下載請求只會送往目前媒體網址本身，執行記錄僅保存在記憶體中供面板檢視。

zh-TW.safety: 腳本僅使用使用者腳本管理器受限的跨來源請求能力，向你正在檢視的同一媒體網址請求檔案，並且只限存取腳本宣告的 @connect 主機。它不會把你的檔案或瀏覽資料上傳給任何第三方。頁面與面板之間的通訊僅限面板自身的來源與目前頁面的來源。執行記錄保存在一個較小的記憶體環形緩衝中，不做持久化；只有面板顯示偏好與連線標記會被保存，透過 GM 儲存並在不可用時回退到 localStorage。下載媒體仍可能受來源網站條款約束，請僅在你擁有儲存內容的權利時使用本腳本。
